verses.first: Happy are they who have not walked in the counsel of the wicked,
verses.second: nor lingered in the way of sinners, nor sat in the seats of the scornful!

verses.first: Their delight is in the law of the Lord,
verses.second: and they meditate on his law day and night.

verses.first: They are like trees planted by streams of water, bearing fruit in due season, with leaves that do not wither;
verses.second: everything they do shall prosper.

verses.first: It is not so with the wicked;
verses.second: they are like chaff which the wind blows away.

verses.first: Therefore the wicked shall not stand upright when judgment comes,
verses.second: nor the sinner in the council of the righteous.

verses.first: For the Lord knows the way of the righteous,
verses.second: but the way of the wicked is doomed.

verses.first: Why are the nations in an uproar?
verses.second: Why do the peoples mutter empty threats?

verses.first: Why do the kings of the earth rise up in revolt, and the princes plot together,
verses.second: against the Lord and against his Anointed?

verses.first: “Let us break their yoke,” they say;
verses.second: “let us cast off their bonds from us.”

verses.first: He whose throne is in heaven is laughing;
verses.second: the Lord has them in derision.

verses.first: Then he speaks to them in his wrath,
verses.second: and his rage fills them with terror.

verses.first: “I myself have set my king
verses.second: upon my holy hill of Zion.”

verses.first: Let me announce the decree of the Lord:
verses.second: he said to me, “You are my Son; this day have I begotten you.

verses.first: Ask of me, and I will give you the nations for your inheritance
verses.second: and the ends of the earth for your possession.

verses.first: You shall crush them with an iron rod
verses.second: and shatter them like a piece of pottery.”

verses.first: And now, you kings, be wise;
verses.second: be warned, you rulers of the earth.

verses.first: Submit to the Lord with fear,
verses.second: and with trembling bow before him;

verses.first: Lest he be angry and you perish;
verses.second: for his wrath is quickly kindled.

verses.first: Happy are they all
verses.second: who take refuge in him!

verses.first: Lord, how many adversaries I have!
verses.second: how many there are who rise up against me!

verses.first: How many there are who say of me,
verses.second: “There is no help for him in his God.”

verses.first: But you, O Lord, are a shield about me;
verses.second: you are my glory, the one who lifts up my head.

verses.first: I call aloud upon the Lord,
verses.second: and he answers me from his holy hill;

verses.first: I lie down and go to sleep;
verses.second: I wake again, because the Lord sustains me.

verses.first: I do not fear the multitudes of people
verses.second: who set themselves against me all around.

verses.first: Rise up, O Lord; set me free, O my God;
verses.second: surely, you will strike all my enemies across the face, you will break the teeth of the wicked.

verses.first: Deliverance belongs to the Lord.
verses.second: Your blessing be upon your people!

verses.first: Answer me when I call, O God, defender of my cause;
verses.second: you set me free when I am hard-pressed; have mercy on me and hear my prayer.

verses.first: “You mortals, how long will you dishonor my glory;
verses.second: how long will you worship dumb idols and run after false gods?”

verses.first: Know that the Lord does wonders for the faithful;
verses.second: when I call upon the Lord, he will hear me.

verses.first: Tremble, then, and do not sin;
verses.second: speak to your heart in silence upon your bed.

verses.first: Offer the appointed sacrifices
verses.second: and put your trust in the Lord.

verses.first: Many are saying, “Oh, that we might see better times!”
verses.second: Lift up the light of your countenance upon us, O Lord.

verses.first: You have put gladness in my heart,
verses.second: more than when grain and wine and oil increase.

verses.first: I lie down in peace; at once I fall asleep;
verses.second: for only you, Lord, make me dwell in safety.

verses.first: Give ear to my words, O Lord;
verses.second: consider my meditation.

verses.first: Hearken to my cry for help, my King and my God,
verses.second: for I make my prayer to you.

verses.first: In the morning, Lord, you hear my voice;
verses.second: early in the morning I make my appeal and watch for you.

verses.first: For you are not a God who takes pleasure in wickedness,
verses.second: and evil cannot dwell with you.

verses.first: Braggarts cannot stand in your sight;
verses.second: you hate all those who work wickedness.

verses.first: You destroy those who speak lies;
verses.second: the bloodthirsty and deceitful, O Lord, you abhor.

verses.first: But as for me, through the greatness of your mercy I will go into your house;
verses.second: I will bow down toward your holy temple in awe of you.

verses.first: Lead me, O Lord, in your righteousness, because of those who lie in wait for me;
verses.second: make your way straight before me.

verses.first: For there is no truth in their mouth;
verses.second: there is destruction in their heart;

verses.first: Their throat is an open grave;
verses.second: they flatter with their tongue.

verses.first: Declare them guilty, O God;
verses.second: let them fall, because of their schemes.

verses.first: Because of their many transgressions cast them out,
verses.second: for they have rebelled against you.

verses.first: But all who take refuge in you will be glad;
verses.second: they will sing out their joy for ever.

verses.first: You will shelter them,
verses.second: so that those who love your Name may exult in you.

verses.first: For you, O Lord, will bless the righteous;
verses.second: you will defend them with your favor as with a shield.

verses.first: Lord, do not rebuke me in your anger;
verses.second: do not punish me in your wrath.

verses.first: Have pity on me, Lord, for I am weak;
verses.second: heal me, Lord, for my bones are racked.

verses.first: My spirit shakes with terror;
verses.second: how long, O Lord, how long?

verses.first: Turn, O Lord, and deliver me;
verses.second: save me for your mercy’s sake.

verses.first: For in death no one remembers you;
verses.second: and who will give you thanks in the grave?

verses.first: I grow weary because of my groaning;
verses.second: every night I drench my bed and flood my couch with tears.

verses.first: My eyes are wasted with grief
verses.second: and worn away because of all my enemies.

verses.first: Depart from me, all evildoers,
verses.second: for the Lord has heard the sound of my weeping.

verses.first: The Lord has heard my supplication;
verses.second: the Lord accepts my prayer.

verses.first: All my enemies shall be confounded and quake with fear;
verses.second: they shall turn back and suddenly be put to shame.

verses.first: O Lord my God, I take refuge in you;
verses.second: save and deliver me from all who pursue me;

verses.first: Lest like a lion they tear me in pieces
verses.second: and snatch me away with none to deliver me.

verses.first: O Lord my God, if I have done these things:
verses.second: if there is any wickedness in my hands,

verses.first: If I have repaid my friend with evil,
verses.second: or plundered him who without cause is my enemy;

verses.first: Then let my enemy pursue and overtake me,
verses.second: trample my life into the ground, and lay my honor in the dust.

verses.first: Stand up, O Lord, in your wrath;
verses.second: rise up against the fury of my enemies.

verses.first: Awake, O my God, decree justice;
verses.second: let the assembly of the peoples gather round you.

verses.first: Be seated on your lofty throne, O Most High;
verses.second: O Lord, judge the nations.

verses.first: Give judgment for me according to my righteousness, O Lord,
verses.second: and according to my innocence, O Most High.

verses.first: Let the malice of the wicked come to an end, but establish the righteous;
verses.second: for you test the mind and heart, O righteous God.

verses.first: God is my shield and defense;
verses.second: he is the savior of the true in heart.

verses.first: God is a righteous judge;
verses.second: God sits in judgment every day.

verses.first: If they will not repent, God will whet his sword;
verses.second: he will bend his bow and make it ready.

verses.first: He has prepared his weapons of death;
verses.second: he makes his arrows shafts of fire.

verses.first: Look at those who are in labor with wickedness,
verses.second: who conceive evil, and give birth to a lie.

verses.first: They dig a pit and make it deep
verses.second: and fall into the hole that they have made.

verses.first: Their malice turns back upon their own head;
verses.second: their violence falls on their own scalp.

verses.first: I will bear witness that the Lord is righteous;
verses.second: I will praise the Name of the Lord Most High.

verses.first: O Lord our Governor,
verses.second: how exalted is your Name in all the world!

verses.first: Out of the mouths of infants and children
verses.second: your majesty is praised above the heavens.

verses.first: You have set up a stronghold against your adversaries,
verses.second: to quell the enemy and the avenger.

verses.first: When I consider your heavens, the work of your fingers,
verses.second: the moon and the stars you have set in their courses,

verses.first: What is man that you should be mindful of him?
verses.second: the son of man that you should seek him out?

verses.first: You have made him but little lower than the angels;
verses.second: you adorn him with glory and honor;

verses.first: You give him mastery over the works of your hands;
verses.second: you put all things under his feet:

verses.first: All sheep and oxen,
verses.second: even the wild beasts of the field,

verses.first: The birds of the air, the fish of the sea,
verses.second: and whatsoever walks in the paths of the sea.

verses.first: O Lord our Governor,
verses.second: how exalted is your Name in all the world!

verses.first: I will give thanks to you, O Lord, with my whole heart;
verses.second: I will tell of all your marvelous works.

verses.first: I will be glad and rejoice in you;
verses.second: I will sing to your Name, O Most High.

verses.first: When my enemies are driven back,
verses.second: they will stumble and perish at your presence.

verses.first: For you have maintained my right and my cause;
verses.second: you sit upon your throne judging right.

verses.first: You have rebuked the ungodly and destroyed the wicked;
verses.second: you have blotted out their name for ever and ever.

verses.first: As for the enemy, they are finished, in perpetual ruin,
verses.second: their cities ploughed under, the memory of them perished;

verses.first: But the Lord is enthroned for ever;
verses.second: he has set up his throne for judgment.

verses.first: It is he who rules the world with righteousness;
verses.second: he judges the peoples with equity.

verses.first: The Lord will be a refuge for the oppressed,
verses.second: a refuge in time of trouble.

verses.first: Those who know your Name will put their trust in you,
verses.second: for you never forsake those who seek you, O Lord.

verses.first: Sing praise to the Lord who dwells in Zion;
verses.second: proclaim to the peoples the things he has done.

verses.first: The Avenger of blood will remember them;
verses.second: he will not forget the cry of the afflicted.

verses.first: Have pity on me, O Lord;
verses.second: see the misery I suffer from those who hate me, O you who lift me up from the gate of death;

verses.first: So that I may tell of all your praises and rejoice in your salvation
verses.second: in the gates of the city of Zion.

verses.first: The ungodly have fallen into the pit they dug,
verses.second: and in the snare they set is their own foot caught.

verses.first: The Lord is known by his acts of justice;
verses.second: the wicked are trapped in the works of their own hands.

verses.first: The wicked shall be given over to the grave,
verses.second: and also all the peoples that forget God.

verses.first: For the needy shall not always be forgotten,
verses.second: and the hope of the poor shall not perish for ever.

verses.first: Rise up, O Lord, let not the ungodly have the upper hand;
verses.second: let them be judged before you.

verses.first: Put fear upon them, O Lord;
verses.second: let the ungodly know they are but mortal.

verses.first: Why do you stand so far off, O Lord,
verses.second: and hide yourself in time of trouble?

verses.first: The wicked arrogantly persecute the poor,
verses.second: but they are trapped in the schemes they have devised.

verses.first: The wicked boast of their heart’s desire;
verses.second: the covetous curse and revile the Lord.

verses.first: The wicked are so proud that they care not for God;
verses.second: their only thought is, “God does not matter.”

verses.first: Their ways are devious at all times; your judgments are far above out of their sight;
verses.second: they defy all their enemies.

verses.first: They say in their heart, “I shall not be shaken;
verses.second: no harm shall happen to me ever.”

verses.first: Their mouth is full of cursing, deceit, and oppression;
verses.second: under their tongue are mischief and wrong.

verses.first: They lurk in ambush in public squares and in secret places they murder the innocent;
verses.second: they spy out the helpless.

verses.first: They lie in wait, like a lion in a covert; they lie in wait to seize upon the lowly;
verses.second: they seize the lowly and drag them away in their net.

verses.first: The innocent are broken and humbled before them;
verses.second: the helpless fall before their power.

verses.first: They say in their heart, “God has forgotten;
verses.second: he hides his face; he will never notice.”

verses.first: Rise up, O Lord; lift up your hand, O God;
verses.second: do not forget the afflicted.

verses.first: Why should the wicked revile God?
verses.second: why should they say in their heart, “You do not care”?

verses.first: Surely, you behold trouble and misery;
verses.second: you see it and take it into your own hand.

verses.first: The helpless commit themselves to you,
verses.second: for you are the helper of orphans.

verses.first: Break the power of the wicked and evil;
verses.second: search out their wickedness until you find none.

verses.first: The Lord is King for ever and ever;
verses.second: the ungodly shall perish from his land.

verses.first: The Lord will hear the desire of the humble;
verses.second: you will strengthen their heart and your ears shall hear;

verses.first: To give justice to the orphan and oppressed,
verses.second: so that mere mortals may strike terror no more.

verses.first: In the Lord have I taken refuge;
verses.second: how then can you say to me, “Fly away like a bird to the hilltop;

verses.first: For see how the wicked bend the bow and fit their arrows to the string,
verses.second: to shoot from ambush at the true of heart.

verses.first: When the foundations are being destroyed,
verses.second: what can the righteous do?”

verses.first: The Lord is in his holy temple;
verses.second: the Lord’s throne is in heaven.

verses.first: His eyes behold the inhabited world;
verses.second: his piercing eye weighs our worth.

verses.first: The Lord weighs the righteous as well as the wicked,
verses.second: but those who delight in violence he abhors.

verses.first: Upon the wicked he shall rain coals of fire and burning sulphur;
verses.second: a scorching wind shall be their lot.

verses.first: For the Lord is righteous; he delights in righteous deeds;
verses.second: and the just shall see his face.

verses.first: Help me, Lord, for there is no godly one left;
verses.second: the faithful have vanished from among us.

verses.first: Everyone speaks falsely with his neighbor;
verses.second: with a smooth tongue they speak from a double heart.

verses.first: Oh, that the Lord would cut off all smooth tongues,
verses.second: and close the lips that utter proud boasts!

verses.first: Those who say, “With our tongue will we prevail;
verses.second: our lips are our own; who is lord over us?”

verses.first: “Because the needy are oppressed, and the poor cry out in misery,
verses.second: I will rise up,” says the Lord, “and give them the help they long for.”

verses.first: The words of the Lord are pure words,
verses.second: like silver refined from ore and purified seven times in the fire.

verses.first: O Lord, watch over us
verses.second: and save us from this generation for ever.

verses.first: The wicked prowl on every side,
verses.second: and that which is worthless is highly prized by everyone.

verses.first: How long, O Lord? will you forget me for ever?
verses.second: how long will you hide your face from me?

verses.first: How long shall I have perplexity in my mind, and grief in my heart, day after day?
verses.second: how long shall my enemy triumph over me?

verses.first: Look upon me and answer me, O Lord my God;
verses.second: give light to my eyes, lest I sleep in death;

verses.first: Lest my enemy say, “I have prevailed over him,”
verses.second: and my foes rejoice that I have fallen.

verses.first: But I put my trust in your mercy;
verses.second: my heart is joyful because of your saving help.

verses.first: I will sing to the Lord, for he has dealt with me richly;
verses.second: I will praise the Name of the Lord Most High.

verses.first: The fool has said in his heart, “There is no God.”
verses.second: All are corrupt and commit abominable acts; there is none who does any good.

verses.first: The Lord looks down from heaven upon us all,
verses.second: to see if there is any who is wise, if there is one who seeks after God.

verses.first: Every one has proved faithless; all alike have turned bad;
verses.second: there is none who does good; no, not one.

verses.first: Have they no knowledge, all those evildoers
verses.second: who eat up my people like bread and do not call upon the Lord?

verses.first: See how they tremble with fear,
verses.second: because God is in the company of the righteous.

verses.first: Their aim is to confound the plans of the afflicted,
verses.second: but the Lord is their refuge.

verses.first: Oh, that Israel’s deliverance would come out of Zion!
verses.second: when the Lord restores the fortunes of his people, Jacob will rejoice and Israel be glad.

verses.first: Lord, who may dwell in your tabernacle?
verses.second: who may abide upon your holy hill?

verses.first: Whoever leads a blameless life and does what is right,
verses.second: who speaks the truth from his heart.

verses.first: There is no guile upon his tongue; he does no evil to his friend;
verses.second: he does not heap contempt upon his neighbor.

verses.first: In his sight the wicked is rejected,
verses.second: but he honors those who fear the Lord.

verses.first: He has sworn to do no wrong
verses.second: and does not take back his word.

verses.first: He does not give his money in hope of gain,
verses.second: nor does he take a bribe against the innocent.

verses.first: Whoever does these things
verses.second: shall never be overthrown.

verses.first: Protect me, O God, for I take refuge in you;
verses.second: I have said to the Lord, “You are my Lord, my good above all other.”

verses.first: All my delight is upon the godly that are in the land,
verses.second: upon those who are noble among the people.

verses.first: But those who run after other gods
verses.second: shall have their troubles multiplied.

verses.first: Their libations of blood I will not offer,
verses.second: nor take the names of their gods upon my lips.

verses.first: O Lord, you are my portion and my cup;
verses.second: it is you who uphold my lot.

verses.first: My boundaries enclose a pleasant land;
verses.second: indeed, I have a goodly heritage.

verses.first: I will bless the Lord who gives me counsel;
verses.second: my heart teaches me, night after night.

verses.first: I have set the Lord always before me;
verses.second: because he is at my right hand I shall not fall.

verses.first: My heart, therefore, is glad, and my spirit rejoices;
verses.second: my body also shall rest in hope.

verses.first: For you will not abandon me to the grave,
verses.second: nor let your holy one see the Pit.

verses.first: You will show me the path of life;
verses.second: in your presence there is fullness of joy, and in your right hand are pleasures for evermore.

verses.first: Hear my plea of innocence, O Lord; give heed to my cry;
verses.second: listen to my prayer, which does not come from lying lips.

verses.first: Let my vindication come forth from your presence;
verses.second: let your eyes be fixed on justice.

verses.first: Weigh my heart, summon me by night,
verses.second: melt me down; you will find no impurity in me.

verses.first: I give no offense with my mouth as others do;
verses.second: I have heeded the words of your lips.

verses.first: My footsteps hold fast to the ways of your law;
verses.second: in your paths my feet shall not stumble.

verses.first: I call upon you, O God, for you will answer me;
verses.second: incline your ear to me and hear my words.

verses.first: Show me your marvelous loving-kindness,
verses.second: O Savior of those who take refuge at your right hand from those who rise up against them.

verses.first: Keep me as the apple of your eye;
verses.second: hide me under the shadow of your wings,

verses.first: From the wicked who assault me,
verses.second: from my deadly enemies who surround me.

verses.first: They have closed their heart to pity,
verses.second: and their mouth speaks proud things.

verses.first: They press me hard, now they surround me,
verses.second: watching how they may cast me to the ground,

verses.first: Like a lion, greedy for its prey,
verses.second: and like a young lion lurking in secret places.

verses.first: Arise, O Lord; confront them and bring them down;
verses.second: deliver me from the wicked by your sword.

verses.first: Deliver me, O Lord, by your hand
verses.second: from those whose portion in life is this world;

verses.first: Whose bellies you fill with your treasure,
verses.second: who are well supplied with children and leave their wealth to their little ones.

verses.first: But at my vindication I shall see your face;
verses.second: when I awake, I shall be satisfied, beholding your likeness.

verses.first: I love you, O Lord my strength,
verses.second: O Lord my stronghold, my crag, and my haven.

verses.first: My God, my rock in whom I put my trust,
verses.second: my shield, the horn of my salvation, and my refuge; you are worthy of praise.

verses.first: I will call upon the Lord,
verses.second: and so shall I be saved from my enemies.

verses.first: The breakers of death rolled over me,
verses.second: and the torrents of oblivion made me afraid.

verses.first: The cords of hell entangled me,
verses.second: and the snares of death were set for me.

verses.first: I called upon the Lord in my distress
verses.second: and cried out to my God for help.

verses.first: He heard my voice from his heavenly dwelling;
verses.second: my cry of anguish came to his ears.

verses.first: The earth reeled and rocked;
verses.second: the roots of the mountains shook; they reeled because of his anger.

verses.first: Smoke rose from his nostrils and a consuming fire out of his mouth;
verses.second: hot burning coals blazed forth from him.

verses.first: He parted the heavens and came down
verses.second: with a storm cloud under his feet.

verses.first: He mounted on cherubim and flew;
verses.second: he swooped on the wings of the wind.

verses.first: He wrapped darkness about him;
verses.second: he made dark waters and thick clouds his pavilion.

verses.first: From the brightness of his presence, through the clouds,
verses.second: burst hailstones and coals of fire.

verses.first: The Lord thundered out of heaven;
verses.second: the Most High uttered his voice.

verses.first: He loosed his arrows and scattered them;
verses.second: he hurled thunderbolts and routed them.

verses.first: The beds of the seas were uncovered, and the foundations of the world laid bare,
verses.second: at your battle cry, O Lord, at the blast of the breath of your nostrils.

verses.first: He reached down from on high and grasped me;
verses.second: he drew me out of great waters.

verses.first: He delivered me from my strong enemies and from those who hated me;
verses.second: for they were too mighty for me.

verses.first: They confronted me in the day of my disaster;
verses.second: but the Lord was my support.

verses.first: He brought me out into an open place;
verses.second: he rescued me because he delighted in me.

verses.first: The Lord rewarded me because of my righteous dealing;
verses.second: because my hands were clean he rewarded me;

verses.first: For I have kept the ways of the Lord
verses.second: and have not offended against my God;

verses.first: For all his judgments are before my eyes,
verses.second: and his decrees I have not put away from me;

verses.first: For I have been blameless with him
verses.second: and have kept myself from iniquity;

verses.first: Therefore the Lord rewarded me according to my righteous dealing,
verses.second: because of the cleanness of my hands in his sight.

verses.first: With the faithful you show yourself faithful, O God;
verses.second: with the forthright you show yourself forthright.

verses.first: With the pure you show yourself pure,
verses.second: but with the crooked you are wily.

verses.first: You will save a lowly people,
verses.second: but you will humble the haughty eyes.

verses.first: You, O Lord, are my lamp;
verses.second: my God, you make my darkness bright.

verses.first: With you I will break down an enclosure;
verses.second: with the help of my God I will scale any wall.

verses.first: As for God, his ways are perfect; the words of the Lord are tried in the fire;
verses.second: he is a shield to all who trust in him.

verses.first: For who is God, but the Lord?
verses.second: who is the Rock, except our God?

verses.first: It is God who girds me about with strength
verses.second: and makes my way secure.

verses.first: He makes me sure-footed like a deer
verses.second: and lets me stand firm on the heights.

verses.first: He trains my hands for battle
verses.second: and my arms for bending even a bow of bronze.

verses.first: You have given me your shield of victory;
verses.second: your right hand also sustains me; your loving care makes me great.

verses.first: You lengthen my stride beneath me,
verses.second: and my ankles do not give way.

verses.first: I pursue my enemies and overtake them;
verses.second: I will not turn back till I have destroyed them.

verses.first: I strike them down, and they cannot rise;
verses.second: they fall defeated at my feet.

verses.first: You have girded me with strength for the battle;
verses.second: you have cast down my adversaries beneath me; you have put my enemies to flight.

verses.first: I destroy those who hate me; they cry out, but there is none to help them;
verses.second: they cry to the Lord, but he does not answer.

verses.first: I beat them small like dust before the wind;
verses.second: I trample them like mud in the streets.

verses.first: You deliver me from the strife of the peoples;
verses.second: you put me at the head of the nations.

verses.first: A people I have not known shall serve me; no sooner shall they hear than they shall obey me;
verses.second: strangers will cringe before me.

verses.first: The foreign peoples will lose heart;
verses.second: they shall come trembling out of their strongholds.

verses.first: The Lord lives! Blessed is my Rock!
verses.second: Exalted is the God of my salvation!

verses.first: He is the God who gave me victory
verses.second: and cast down the peoples beneath me.

verses.first: You rescued me from the fury of my enemies; you exalted me above those who rose against me;
verses.second: you saved me from my deadly foe.

verses.first: Therefore will I extol you among the nations, O Lord,
verses.second: and sing praises to your Name.

verses.first: He multiplies the victories of his king;
verses.second: he shows loving-kindness to his anointed, to David and his descendants for ever.

verses.first: The heavens declare the glory of God,
verses.second: and the firmament shows his handiwork.

verses.first: One day tells its tale to another,
verses.second: and one night imparts knowledge to another.

verses.first: Although they have no words or language,
verses.second: and their voices are not heard,

verses.first: Their sound has gone out into all lands,
verses.second: and their message to the ends of the world.

verses.first: In the deep has he set a pavilion for the sun;
verses.second: it comes forth like a bridegroom out of his chamber; it rejoices like a champion to run its course.

verses.first: It goes forth from the uttermost edge of the heavens and runs about to the end of it again;
verses.second: nothing is hidden from its burning heat.

verses.first: The law of the Lord is perfect and revives the soul;
verses.second: the testimony of the Lord is sure and gives wisdom to the innocent.

verses.first: The statutes of the Lord are just and rejoice the heart;
verses.second: the commandment of the Lord is clear and gives light to the eyes.

verses.first: The fear of the Lord is clean and endures for ever;
verses.second: the judgments of the Lord are true and righteous altogether.

verses.first: More to be desired are they than gold, more than much fine gold,
verses.second: sweeter far than honey, than honey in the comb.

verses.first: By them also is your servant enlightened,
verses.second: and in keeping them there is great reward.

verses.first: Who can tell how often he offends?
verses.second: cleanse me from my secret faults.

verses.first: Above all, keep your servant from presumptuous sins; let them not get dominion over me;
verses.second: then shall I be whole and sound, and innocent of a great offense.

verses.first: Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be acceptable in your sight,
verses.second: O Lord, my strength and my redeemer.

verses.first: May the Lord answer you in the day of trouble,
verses.second: the Name of the God of Jacob defend you;

verses.first: Send you help from his holy place
verses.second: and strengthen you out of Zion;

verses.first: Remember all your offerings
verses.second: and accept your burnt sacrifice;

verses.first: Grant you your heart’s desire
verses.second: and prosper all your plans.

verses.first: We will shout for joy at your victory and triumph in the Name of our God;
verses.second: may the Lord grant all your requests.

verses.first: Now I know that the Lord gives victory to his anointed;
verses.second: he will answer him out of his holy heaven, with the victorious strength of his right hand.

verses.first: Some put their trust in chariots and some in horses,
verses.second: but we will call upon the Name of the Lord our God.

verses.first: They collapse and fall down,
verses.second: but we will arise and stand upright. 9O Lord, give victory to the king * and answer us when we call.

verses.first: The king rejoices in your strength, O Lord;
verses.second: how greatly he exults in your victory!

verses.first: You have given him his heart’s desire;
verses.second: you have not denied him the request of his lips.

verses.first: For you meet him with blessings of prosperity,
verses.second: and set a crown of fine gold upon his head.

verses.first: He asked you for life, and you gave it to him:
verses.second: length of days, for ever and ever.

verses.first: His honor is great, because of your victory;
verses.second: splendor and majesty have you bestowed upon him.

verses.first: For you will give him everlasting felicity
verses.second: and will make him glad with the joy of your presence.

verses.first: For the king puts his trust in the Lord;
verses.second: because of the loving-kindness of the Most High, he will not fall.

verses.first: Your hand will lay hold upon all your enemies;
verses.second: your right hand will seize all those who hate you.

verses.first: You will make them like a fiery furnace
verses.second: at the time of your appearing, O Lord;

verses.first: You will swallow them up in your wrath,
verses.second: and fire shall consume them.

verses.first: You will destroy their offspring from the land
verses.second: and their descendants from among the peoples of the earth.

verses.first: Though they intend evil against you and devise wicked schemes,
verses.second: yet they shall not prevail.

verses.first: For you will put them to flight
verses.second: and aim your arrows at them.

verses.first: Be exalted, O Lord, in your might;
verses.second: we will sing and praise your power.

verses.first: My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?
verses.second: and are so far from my cry and from the words of my distress?

verses.first: O my God, I cry in the daytime, but you do not answer;
verses.second: by night as well, but I find no rest.

verses.first: Yet you are the Holy One,
verses.second: enthroned upon the praises of Israel.

verses.first: Our forefathers put their trust in you;
verses.second: they trusted, and you delivered them.

verses.first: They cried out to you and were delivered;
verses.second: they trusted in you and were not put to shame.

verses.first: But as for me, I am a worm and no man,
verses.second: scorned by all and despised by the people.

verses.first: All who see me laugh me to scorn;
verses.second: they curl their lips and wag their heads, saying,

verses.first: “He trusted in the Lord; let him deliver him;
verses.second: let him rescue him, if he delights in him.”

verses.first: Yet you are he who took me out of the womb,
verses.second: and kept me safe upon my mother’s breast.

verses.first: I have been entrusted to you ever since I was born;
verses.second: you were my God when I was still in my mother’s womb.

verses.first: Be not far from me, for trouble is near,
verses.second: and there is none to help.

verses.first: Many young bulls encircle me;
verses.second: strong bulls of Bashan surround me.

verses.first: They open wide their jaws at me,
verses.second: like a ravening and a roaring lion.

verses.first: I am poured out like water; all my bones are out of joint;
verses.second: my heart within my breast is melting wax.

verses.first: My mouth is dried out like a pot-sherd; my tongue sticks to the roof of my mouth;
verses.second: and you have laid me in the dust of the grave.

verses.first: Packs of dogs close me in, and gangs of evildoers circle around me;
verses.second: they pierce my hands and my feet; I can count all my bones.

verses.first: They stare and gloat over me;
verses.second: they divide my garments among them; they cast lots for my clothing.

verses.first: Be not far away, O Lord;
verses.second: you are my strength; hasten to help me.

verses.first: Save me from the sword,
verses.second: my life from the power of the dog.

verses.first: Save me from the lion’s mouth,
verses.second: my wretched body from the horns of wild bulls.

verses.first: I will declare your Name to my brethren;
verses.second: in the midst of the congregation I will praise you.

verses.first: Praise the Lord, you that fear him;
verses.second: stand in awe of him, O offspring of Israel; all you of Jacob’s line, give glory.

verses.first: For he does not despise nor abhor the poor in their poverty; neither does he hide his face from them;
verses.second: but when they cry to him he hears them.

verses.first: My praise is of him in the great assembly;
verses.second: I will perform my vows in the presence of those who worship him.

verses.first: The poor shall eat and be satisfied, and those who seek the Lord shall praise him:
verses.second: “May your heart live for ever!”

verses.first: All the ends of the earth shall remember and turn to the Lord,
verses.second: and all the families of the nations shall bow before him.

verses.first: For kingship belongs to the Lord;
verses.second: he rules over the nations.

verses.first: To him alone all who sleep in the earth bow down in worship;
verses.second: all who go down to the dust fall before him.

verses.first: My soul shall live for him; my descendants shall serve him;
verses.second: they shall be known as the Lord’s for ever.

verses.first: They shall come and make known to a people yet unborn
verses.second: the saving deeds that he has done.

verses.first: The Lord is my shepherd;
verses.second: I shall not be in want.

verses.first: He makes me lie down in green pastures
verses.second: and leads me beside still waters.

verses.first: He revives my soul
verses.second: and guides me along right pathways for his Name’s sake.

verses.first: Though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I shall fear no evil;
verses.second: for you are with me; your rod and your staff, they comfort me.

verses.first: You spread a table before me in the presence of those who trouble me;
verses.second: you have anointed my head with oil, and my cup is running over.

verses.first: Surely your goodness and mercy shall follow me all the days of my life,
verses.second: and I will dwell in the house of the Lord for ever.

verses.first: The earth is the Lord’s and all that is in it,
verses.second: the world and all who dwell therein.

verses.first: For it is he who founded it upon the seas
verses.second: and made it firm upon the rivers of the deep.

verses.first: “Who can ascend the hill of the Lord?
verses.second: and who can stand in his holy place?”

verses.first: “Those who have clean hands and a pure heart,
verses.second: who have not pledged themselves to falsehood, nor sworn by what is a fraud.

verses.first: They shall receive a blessing from the Lord
verses.second: and a just reward from the God of their salvation.”

verses.first: Such is the generation of those who seek him,
verses.second: of those who seek your face, O God of Jacob.

verses.first: Lift up your heads, O gates; lift them high, O everlasting doors;
verses.second: and the King of glory shall come in.

verses.first: “Who is this King of glory?”
verses.second: “The Lord, strong and mighty, the Lord, mighty in battle.”

verses.first: Lift up your heads, O gates; lift them high, O everlasting doors;
verses.second: and the King of glory shall come in.

verses.first: “Who is he, this King of glory?”
verses.second: “The Lord of hosts, he is the King of glory.”

verses.first: To you, O Lord, I lift up my soul; my God, I put my trust in you;
verses.second: let me not be humiliated, nor let my enemies triumph over me.

verses.first: Let none who look to you be put to shame;
verses.second: let the treacherous be disappointed in their schemes.

verses.first: Show me your ways, O Lord,
verses.second: and teach me your paths.

verses.first: Lead me in your truth and teach me,
verses.second: for you are the God of my salvation; in you have I trusted all the day long.

verses.first: Remember, O Lord, your compassion and love,
verses.second: for they are from everlasting.

verses.first: Remember not the sins of my youth and my transgressions;
verses.second: remember me according to your love and for the sake of your goodness, O Lord.

verses.first: Gracious and upright is the Lord;
verses.second: therefore he teaches sinners in his way.

verses.first: He guides the humble in doing right
verses.second: and teaches his way to the lowly.

verses.first: All the paths of the Lord are love and faithfulness
verses.second: to those who keep his covenant and his testimonies.

verses.first: For your Name’s sake, O Lord,
verses.second: forgive my sin, for it is great.

verses.first: Who are they who fear the Lord?
verses.second: he will teach them the way that they should choose.

verses.first: They shall dwell in prosperity,
verses.second: and their offspring shall inherit the land.

verses.first: The Lord is a friend to those who fear him
verses.second: and will show them his covenant.

verses.first: My eyes are ever looking to the Lord,
verses.second: for he shall pluck my feet out of the net.

verses.first: Turn to me and have pity on me,
verses.second: for I am left alone and in misery.

verses.first: The sorrows of my heart have increased;
verses.second: bring me out of my troubles.

verses.first: Look upon my adversity and misery
verses.second: and forgive me all my sin.

verses.first: Look upon my enemies, for they are many,
verses.second: and they bear a violent hatred against me.

verses.first: Protect my life and deliver me;
verses.second: let me not be put to shame, for I have trusted in you.

verses.first: Let integrity and uprightness preserve me,
verses.second: for my hope has been in you.

verses.first: Deliver Israel, O God,
verses.second: out of all his troubles.

verses.first: Give judgment for me, O Lord, for I have lived with integrity;
verses.second: I have trusted in the Lord and have not faltered.

verses.first: Test me, O Lord, and try me;
verses.second: examine my heart and my mind.

verses.first: For your love is before my eyes;
verses.second: I have walked faithfully with you.

verses.first: I have not sat with the worthless,
verses.second: nor do I consort with the deceitful.

verses.first: I have hated the company of evildoers;
verses.second: I will not sit down with the wicked.

verses.first: I will wash my hands in innocence, O Lord,
verses.second: that I may go in procession round your altar,

verses.first: Singing aloud a song of thanksgiving
verses.second: and recounting all your wonderful deeds.

verses.first: Lord, I love the house in which you dwell
verses.second: and the place where your glory abides.

verses.first: Do not sweep me away with sinners,
verses.second: nor my life with those who thirst for blood,

verses.first: Whose hands are full of evil plots,
verses.second: and their right hand full of bribes.

verses.first: As for me, I will live with integrity;
verses.second: redeem me, O Lord, and have pity on me.

verses.first: My foot stands on level ground;
verses.second: in the full assembly I will bless the Lord.

verses.first: The Lord is my light and my salvation; whom then shall I fear?
verses.second: the Lord is the strength of my life; of whom then shall I be afraid?

verses.first: When evildoers came upon me to eat up my flesh,
verses.second: it was they, my foes and my adversaries, who stumbled and fell.

verses.first: Though an army should encamp against me,
verses.second: yet my heart shall not be afraid;

verses.first: And though war should rise up against me,
verses.second: yet will I put my trust in him.

verses.first: One thing have I asked of the Lord; one thing I seek;
verses.second: that I may dwell in the house of the Lord all the days of my life;

verses.first: To behold the fair beauty of the Lord
verses.second: and to seek him in his temple.

verses.first: For in the day of trouble he shall keep me safe in his shelter;
verses.second: he shall hide me in the secrecy of his dwelling and set me high upon a rock.

verses.first: Even now he lifts up my head
verses.second: above my enemies round about me.

verses.first: Therefore I will offer in his dwelling an oblation with sounds of great gladness;
verses.second: I will sing and make music to the Lord.

verses.first: Hearken to my voice, O Lord, when I call;
verses.second: have mercy on me and answer me.

verses.first: You speak in my heart and say, “Seek my face.”
verses.second: Your face, Lord, will I seek.

verses.first: Hide not your face from me,
verses.second: nor turn away your servant in displeasure.

verses.first: You have been my helper; cast me not away;
verses.second: do not forsake me, O God of my salvation.

verses.first: Though my father and my mother forsake me,
verses.second: the Lord will sustain me.

verses.first: Show me your way, O Lord;
verses.second: lead me on a level path, because of my enemies.

verses.first: Deliver me not into the hand of my adversaries,
verses.second: for false witnesses have risen up against me, and also those who speak malice.

verses.first: What if I had not believed that I should see the goodness of the Lord
verses.second: in the land of the living!

verses.first: O tarry and await the Lord’s pleasure; be strong, and he shall comfort your heart;
verses.second: wait patiently for the Lord.

verses.first: O Lord, I call to you; my Rock, do not be deaf to my cry;
verses.second: lest, if you do not hear me, I become like those who go down to the Pit.

verses.first: Hear the voice of my prayer when I cry out to you,
verses.second: when I lift up my hands to your holy of holies.

verses.first: Do not snatch me away with the wicked or with the evildoers,
verses.second: who speak peaceably with their neighbors, while strife is in their hearts.

verses.first: Repay them according to their deeds,
verses.second: and according to the wickedness of their actions.

verses.first: According to the work of their hands repay them,
verses.second: and give them their just deserts.

verses.first: They have no understanding of the Lord’s doings, nor of the works of his hands;
verses.second: therefore he will break them down and not build them up.

verses.first: Blessed is the Lord!
verses.second: for he has heard the voice of my prayer.

verses.first: The Lord is my strength and my shield;
verses.second: my heart trusts in him, and I have been helped;

verses.first: Therefore my heart dances for joy,
verses.second: and in my song will I praise him.

verses.first: The Lord is the strength of his people,
verses.second: a safe refuge for his anointed.

verses.first: Save your people and bless your inheritance;
verses.second: shepherd them and carry them for ever.

verses.first: Ascribe to the Lord, you gods,
verses.second: ascribe to the Lord glory and strength.

verses.first: Ascribe to the Lord the glory due his Name;
verses.second: worship the Lord in the beauty of holiness.

verses.first: The voice of the Lord is upon the waters; the God of glory thunders;
verses.second: the Lord is upon the mighty waters.

verses.first: The voice of the Lord is a powerful voice;
verses.second: the voice of the Lord is a voice of splendor.

verses.first: The voice of the Lord breaks the cedar trees;
verses.second: the Lord breaks the cedars of Lebanon;

verses.first: He makes Lebanon skip like a calf,
verses.second: and Mount Hermon like a young wild ox.

verses.first: The voice of the Lord splits the flames of fire; the voice of the Lord shakes the wilderness;
verses.second: the Lord shakes the wilderness of Kadesh.

verses.first: The voice of the Lord makes the oak trees writhe
verses.second: and strips the forests bare.

verses.first: And in the temple of the Lord
verses.second: all are crying, “Glory!”

verses.first: The Lord sits enthroned above the flood;
verses.second: the Lord sits enthroned as King for evermore.

verses.first: The Lord shall give strength to his people;
verses.second: the Lord shall give his people the blessing of peace.

verses.first: I will exalt you, O Lord, because you have lifted me up
verses.second: and have not let my enemies triumph over me.

verses.first: O Lord my God, I cried out to you,
verses.second: and you restored me to health.

verses.first: You brought me up, O Lord, from the dead;
verses.second: you restored my life as I was going down to the grave.

verses.first: Sing to the Lord, you servants of his;
verses.second: give thanks for the remembrance of his holiness.

verses.first: For his wrath endures but the twinkling of an eye,
verses.second: his favor for a lifetime.

verses.first: Weeping may spend the night,
verses.second: but joy comes in the morning.

verses.first: While I felt secure, I said, “I shall never be disturbed.
verses.second: You, Lord, with your favor, made me as strong as the mountains.”

verses.first: Then you hid your face,
verses.second: and I was filled with fear.

verses.first: I cried to you, O Lord;
verses.second: I pleaded with the Lord, saying,

verses.first: “What profit is there in my blood, if I go down to the Pit?
verses.second: will the dust praise you or declare your faithfulness?

verses.first: Hear, O Lord, and have mercy upon me;
verses.second: O Lord, be my helper.”

verses.first: You have turned my wailing into dancing;
verses.second: you have put off my sack-cloth and clothed me with joy.

verses.first: Therefore my heart sings to you without ceasing;
verses.second: O Lord my God, I will give you thanks for ever.

verses.first: In you, O Lord, have I taken refuge; let me never be put to shame;
verses.second: deliver me in your righteousness.

verses.first: Incline your ear to me;
verses.second: make haste to deliver me.

verses.first: Be my strong rock, a castle to keep me safe, for you are my crag and my stronghold;
verses.second: for the sake of your Name, lead me and guide me.

verses.first: Take me out of the net that they have secretly set for me,
verses.second: for you are my tower of strength.

verses.first: Into your hands I commend my spirit,
verses.second: for you have redeemed me, O Lord, O God of truth.

verses.first: I hate those who cling to worthless idols,
verses.second: and I put my trust in the Lord.

verses.first: I will rejoice and be glad because of your mercy;
verses.second: for you have seen my affliction; you know my distress.

verses.first: You have not shut me up in the power of the enemy;
verses.second: you have set my feet in an open place.

verses.first: Have mercy on me, O Lord, for I am in trouble;
verses.second: my eye is consumed with sorrow, and also my throat and my belly.

verses.first: For my life is wasted with grief, and my years with sighing;
verses.second: my strength fails me because of affliction, and my bones are consumed.

verses.first: I have become a reproach to all my enemies and even to my neighbors, a dismay to those of my acquaintance;
verses.second: when they see me in the street they avoid me.

verses.first: I am forgotten like a dead man, out of mind;
verses.second: I am as useless as a broken pot.

verses.first: For I have heard the whispering of the crowd; fear is all around;
verses.second: they put their heads together against me; they plot to take my life.

verses.first: But as for me, I have trusted in you, O Lord.
verses.second: I have said, “You are my God.

verses.first: My times are in your hand;
verses.second: rescue me from the hand of my enemies, and from those who persecute me.

verses.first: Make your face to shine upon your servant,
verses.second: and in your loving-kindness save me.”

verses.first: Lord, let me not be ashamed for having called upon you;
verses.second: rather, let the wicked be put to shame; let them be silent in the grave.

verses.first: Let the lying lips be silenced which speak against the righteous,
verses.second: haughtily, disdainfully, and with contempt.

verses.first: How great is your goodness, O Lord! which you have laid up for those who fear you;
verses.second: which you have done in the sight of all for those who put their trust in you.

verses.first: You hide them in the covert of your presence from those who slander them;
verses.second: you keep them in your shelter from the strife of tongues.

verses.first: Blessed be the Lord!
verses.second: for he has shown me the wonders of his love in a besieged city.

verses.first: Yet I said in my alarm, “I have been cut off from the sight of your eyes.”
verses.second: Nevertheless, you heard the sound of my entreaty when I cried out to you.

verses.first: Love the Lord, all you who worship him;
verses.second: the Lord protects the faithful, but repays to the full those who act haughtily.

verses.first: Be strong and let your heart take courage,
verses.second: all you who wait for the Lord.

verses.first: Happy are they whose transgressions are forgiven,
verses.second: and whose sin is put away!

verses.first: Happy are they to whom the Lord imputes no guilt,
verses.second: and in whose spirit there is no guile!

verses.first: While I held my tongue, my bones withered away,
verses.second: because of my groaning all day long.

verses.first: For your hand was heavy upon me day and night;
verses.second: my moisture was dried up as in the heat of summer.

verses.first: Then I acknowledged my sin to you,
verses.second: and did not conceal my guilt.

verses.first: I said, “I will confess my transgressions to the Lord.”
verses.second: Then you forgave me the guilt of my sin.

verses.first: Therefore all the faithful will make their prayers to you in time of trouble;
verses.second: when the great waters overflow, they shall not reach them.

verses.first: You are my hiding-place; you preserve me from trouble;
verses.second: you surround me with shouts of deliverance.

verses.first: “I will instruct you and teach you in the way that you should go;
verses.second: I will guide you with my eye.

verses.first: Do not be like horse or mule, which have no understanding;
verses.second: who must be fitted with bit and bridle, or else they will not stay near you.”

verses.first: Great are the tribulations of the wicked;
verses.second: but mercy embraces those who trust in the Lord.

verses.first: Be glad, you righteous, and rejoice in the Lord;
verses.second: shout for joy, all who are true of heart.

verses.first: Rejoice in the Lord, you righteous;
verses.second: it is good for the just to sing praises.

verses.first: Praise the Lord with the harp;
verses.second: play to him upon the psaltery and lyre.

verses.first: Sing for him a new song;
verses.second: sound a fanfare with all your skill upon the trumpet.

verses.first: For the word of the Lord is right,
verses.second: and all his works are sure.

verses.first: He loves righteousness and justice;
verses.second: the loving-kindness of the Lord fills the whole earth.

verses.first: By the word of the Lord were the heavens made,
verses.second: by the breath of his mouth all the heavenly hosts.

verses.first: He gathers up the waters of the ocean as in a water-skin
verses.second: and stores up the depths of the sea.

verses.first: Let all the earth fear the Lord;
verses.second: let all who dwell in the world stand in awe of him.

verses.first: For he spoke, and it came to pass;
verses.second: he commanded, and it stood fast.

verses.first: The Lord brings the will of the nations to naught;
verses.second: he thwarts the designs of the peoples.

verses.first: But the Lord’s will stands fast for ever,
verses.second: and the designs of his heart from age to age.

verses.first: Happy is the nation whose God is the Lord!
verses.second: happy the people he has chosen to be his own!

verses.first: The Lord looks down from heaven,
verses.second: and beholds all the people in the world.

verses.first: From where he sits enthroned he turns his gaze
verses.second: on all who dwell on the earth.

verses.first: He fashions all the hearts of them
verses.second: and understands all their works.

verses.first: There is no king that can be saved by a mighty army;
verses.second: a strong man is not delivered by his great strength.

verses.first: The horse is a vain hope for deliverance;
verses.second: for all its strength it cannot save.

verses.first: Behold, the eye of the Lord is upon those who fear him,
verses.second: on those who wait upon his love,

verses.first: To pluck their lives from death,
verses.second: and to feed them in time of famine.

verses.first: Our soul waits for the Lord;
verses.second: he is our help and our shield.

verses.first: Indeed, our heart rejoices in him,
verses.second: for in his holy Name we put our trust.

verses.first: Let your loving-kindness, O Lord, be upon us,
verses.second: as we have put our trust in you.

verses.first: I will bless the Lord at all times;
verses.second: his praise shall ever be in my mouth.

verses.first: I will glory in the Lord;
verses.second: let the humble hear and rejoice.

verses.first: Proclaim with me the greatness of the Lord;
verses.second: let us exalt his Name together.

verses.first: I sought the Lord, and he answered me
verses.second: and delivered me out of all my terror.

verses.first: Look upon him and be radiant,
verses.second: and let not your faces be ashamed.

verses.first: I called in my affliction and the Lord heard me
verses.second: and saved me from all my troubles.

verses.first: The angel of the Lord encompasses those who fear him,
verses.second: and he will deliver them.

verses.first: Taste and see that the Lord is good;
verses.second: happy are they who trust in him!

verses.first: Fear the Lord, you that are his saints,
verses.second: for those who fear him lack nothing.

verses.first: The young lions lack and suffer hunger,
verses.second: but those who seek the Lord lack nothing that is good.

verses.first: Come, children, and listen to me;
verses.second: I will teach you the fear of the Lord.

verses.first: Who among you loves life
verses.second: and desires long life to enjoy prosperity?

verses.first: Keep your tongue from evil-speaking
verses.second: and your lips from lying words.

verses.first: Turn from evil and do good;
verses.second: seek peace and pursue it.

verses.first: The eyes of the Lord are upon the righteous,
verses.second: and his ears are open to their cry.

verses.first: The face of the Lord is against those who do evil,
verses.second: to root out the remembrance of them from the earth.

verses.first: The righteous cry, and the Lord hears them
verses.second: and delivers them from all their troubles.

verses.first: The Lord is near to the brokenhearted
verses.second: and will save those whose spirits are crushed.

verses.first: Many are the troubles of the righteous,
verses.second: but the Lord will deliver him out of them all.

verses.first: He will keep safe all his bones;
verses.second: not one of them shall be broken.

verses.first: Evil shall slay the wicked,
verses.second: and those who hate the righteous will be punished.

verses.first: The Lord ransoms the life of his servants,
verses.second: and none will be punished who trust in him.

verses.first: Fight those who fight me, O Lord;
verses.second: attack those who are attacking me.

verses.first: Take up shield and armor
verses.second: and rise up to help me.

verses.first: Draw the sword and bar the way against those who pursue me;
verses.second: say to my soul, “I am your salvation.”

verses.first: Let those who seek after my life be shamed and humbled,
verses.second: let those who plot my ruin fall back and be dismayed.

verses.first: Let them be like chaff before the wind,
verses.second: and let the angel of the Lord drive them away.

verses.first: Let their way be dark and slippery,
verses.second: and let the angel of the Lord pursue them.

verses.first: For they have secretly spread a net for me without a cause;
verses.second: without a cause they have dug a pit to take me alive.

verses.first: Let ruin come upon them unawares;
verses.second: let them be caught in the net they hid; let them fall into the pit they dug.

verses.first: Then I will be joyful in the Lord;
verses.second: I will glory in his victory.

verses.first: My very bones will say, “Lord, who is like you?
verses.second: You deliver the poor from those who are too strong for them, the poor and needy from those who rob them.”

verses.first: Malicious witnesses rise up against me;
verses.second: they charge me with matters I know nothing about.

verses.first: They pay me evil in exchange for good;
verses.second: my soul is full of despair.

verses.first: But when they were sick I dressed in sack-cloth
verses.second: and humbled myself by fasting;

verses.first: I prayed with my whole heart, as one would for a friend or a brother;
verses.second: I behaved like one who mourns for his mother, bowed down and grieving.

verses.first: But when I stumbled, they were glad and gathered together; they gathered against me;
verses.second: strangers whom I did not know tore me to pieces and would not stop.

verses.first: They put me to the test and mocked me;
verses.second: they gnashed at me with their teeth.

verses.first: O Lord, how long will you look on?
verses.second: rescue me from the roaring beasts, and my life from the young lions.

verses.first: I will give you thanks in the great congregation;
verses.second: I will praise you in the mighty throng.

verses.first: Do not let my treacherous foes rejoice over me,
verses.second: nor let those who hate me without a cause wink at each other.

verses.first: For they do not plan for peace,
verses.second: but invent deceitful schemes against the quiet in the land.

verses.first: They opened their mouths at me and said,
verses.second: “Aha! we saw it with our own eyes.”

verses.first: You saw it, O Lord; do not be silent;
verses.second: O Lord, be not far from me.

verses.first: Awake, arise, to my cause!
verses.second: to my defense, my God and my Lord!

verses.first: Give me justice, O Lord my God, according to your righteousness;
verses.second: do not let them triumph over me.

verses.first: Do not let them say in their hearts, “Aha! just what we want!”
verses.second: Do not let them say, “We have swallowed him up.”

verses.first: Let all who rejoice at my ruin be ashamed and disgraced;
verses.second: let those who boast against me be clothed with dismay and shame.

verses.first: Let those who favor my cause sing out with joy and be glad;
verses.second: let them say always, “Great is the Lord, who desires the prosperity of his servant.”

verses.first: And my tongue shall be talking of your righteousness
verses.second: and of your praise all the day long.

verses.first: There is a voice of rebellion deep in the heart of the wicked;
verses.second: there is no fear of God before his eyes.

verses.first: He flatters himself in his own eyes
verses.second: that his hateful sin will not be found out.

verses.first: The words of his mouth are wicked and deceitful,
verses.second: he has left off acting wisely and doing good.

verses.first: He thinks up wickedness upon his bed and has set himself in no good way;
verses.second: he does not abhor that which is evil.

verses.first: Your love, O Lord, reaches to the heavens,
verses.second: and your faithfulness to the clouds.

verses.first: Your righteousness is like the strong mountains, your justice like the great deep;
verses.second: you save both man and beast, O Lord.

verses.first: How priceless is your love, O God!
verses.second: your people take refuge under the shadow of your wings.

verses.first: They feast upon the abundance of your house;
verses.second: you give them drink from the river of your delights.

verses.first: For with you is the well of life,
verses.second: and in your light we see light.

verses.first: Continue your loving-kindness to those who know you,
verses.second: and your favor to those who are true of heart.

verses.first: Let not the foot of the proud come near me,
verses.second: nor the hand of the wicked push me aside.

verses.first: See how they are fallen, those who work wickedness!
verses.second: they are cast down and shall not be able to rise.

verses.first: Do not fret yourself because of evildoers;
verses.second: do not be jealous of those who do wrong.

verses.first: For they shall soon wither like the grass,
verses.second: and like the green grass fade away.

verses.first: Put your trust in the Lord and do good;
verses.second: dwell in the land and feed on its riches.

verses.first: Take delight in the Lord,
verses.second: and he shall give you your heart’s desire.

verses.first: Commit your way to the Lord and put your trust in him,
verses.second: and he will bring it to pass.

verses.first: He will make your righteousness as clear as the light
verses.second: and your just dealing as the noonday.

verses.first: Be still before the Lord
verses.second: and wait patiently for him.

verses.first: Do not fret yourself over the one who prospers,
verses.second: the one who succeeds in evil schemes.

verses.first: Refrain from anger, leave rage alone;
verses.second: do not fret yourself; it leads only to evil.

verses.first: For evildoers shall be cut off,
verses.second: but those who wait upon the Lord shall possess the land.

verses.first: In a little while the wicked shall be no more;
verses.second: you shall search out their place, but they will not be there.

verses.first: But the lowly shall possess the land;
verses.second: they will delight in abundance of peace.

verses.first: The wicked plot against the righteous
verses.second: and gnash at them with their teeth.

verses.first: The Lord laughs at the wicked,
verses.second: because he sees that their day will come.

verses.first: The wicked draw their sword and bend their bow to strike down the poor and needy,
verses.second: to slaughter those who are upright in their ways.

verses.first: Their sword shall go through their own heart,
verses.second: and their bow shall be broken.

verses.first: The little that the righteous has
verses.second: is better than great riches of the wicked.

verses.first: For the power of the wicked shall be broken,
verses.second: but the Lord upholds the righteous.

verses.first: The Lord cares for the lives of the godly,
verses.second: and their inheritance shall last for ever.

verses.first: They shall not be ashamed in bad times,
verses.second: and in days of famine they shall have enough.

verses.first: As for the wicked, they shall perish,
verses.second: and the enemies of the Lord, like the glory of the meadows, shall vanish; they shall vanish like smoke.

verses.first: The wicked borrow and do not repay,
verses.second: but the righteous are generous in giving.

verses.first: Those who are blessed by God shall possess the land,
verses.second: but those who are cursed by him shall be destroyed.

verses.first: Our steps are directed by the Lord;
verses.second: he strengthens those in whose way he delights.

verses.first: If they stumble, they shall not fall headlong,
verses.second: for the Lord holds them by the hand.

verses.first: I have been young and now I am old,
verses.second: but never have I seen the righteous forsaken, or their children begging bread.

verses.first: The righteous are always generous in their lending,
verses.second: and their children shall be a blessing.

verses.first: Turn from evil, and do good,
verses.second: and dwell in the land for ever.

verses.first: For the Lord loves justice;
verses.second: he does not forsake his faithful ones.

verses.first: They shall be kept safe for ever,
verses.second: but the offspring of the wicked shall be destroyed.

verses.first: The righteous shall possess the land
verses.second: and dwell in it for ever.

verses.first: The mouth of the righteous utters wisdom,
verses.second: and their tongue speaks what is right.

verses.first: The law of their God is in their heart,
verses.second: and their footsteps shall not falter.

verses.first: The wicked spy on the righteous
verses.second: and seek occasion to kill them.

verses.first: The Lord will not abandon them to their hand,
verses.second: nor let them be found guilty when brought to trial.

verses.first: Wait upon the Lord and keep his way;
verses.second: he will raise you up to possess the land, and when the wicked are cut off, you will see it.

verses.first: I have seen the wicked in their arrogance,
verses.second: flourishing like a tree in full leaf.

verses.first: I went by, and behold, they were not there;
verses.second: I searched for them, but they could not be found.

verses.first: Mark those who are honest; observe the upright;
verses.second: for there is a future for the peaceable.

verses.first: Transgressors shall be destroyed, one and all;
verses.second: the future of the wicked is cut off.

verses.first: But the deliverance of the righteous comes from the Lord;
verses.second: he is their stronghold in time of trouble.

verses.first: The Lord will help them and rescue them;
verses.second: he will rescue them from the wicked and deliver them, because they seek refuge in him.

verses.first: O Lord, do not rebuke me in your anger;
verses.second: do not punish me in your wrath.

verses.first: For your arrows have already pierced me,
verses.second: and your hand presses hard upon me.

verses.first: There is no health in my flesh, because of your indignation;
verses.second: there is no soundness in my body, because of my sin.

verses.first: For my iniquities overwhelm me;
verses.second: like a heavy burden they are too much for me to bear.

verses.first: My wounds stink and fester
verses.second: by reason of my foolishness.

verses.first: I am utterly bowed down and prostrate;
verses.second: I go about in mourning all the day long.

verses.first: My loins are filled with searing pain;
verses.second: there is no health in my body.

verses.first: I am utterly numb and crushed;
verses.second: I wail, because of the groaning of my heart.

verses.first: O Lord, you know all my desires,
verses.second: and my sighing is not hidden from you.

verses.first: My heart is pounding, my strength has failed me,
verses.second: and the brightness of my eyes is gone from me.

verses.first: My friends and companions draw back from my affliction;
verses.second: my neighbors stand afar off.

verses.first: Those who seek after my life lay snares for me;
verses.second: those who strive to hurt me speak of my ruin and plot treachery all the day long.

verses.first: But I am like the deaf who do not hear,
verses.second: like those who are mute and do not open their mouth.

verses.first: I have become like one who does not hear
verses.second: and from whose mouth comes no defense.

verses.first: For in you, O Lord, have I fixed my hope;
verses.second: you will answer me, O Lord my God.

verses.first: For I said, “Do not let them rejoice at my expense,
verses.second: those who gloat over me when my foot slips.”

verses.first: Truly, I am on the verge of falling,
verses.second: and my pain is always with me.

verses.first: I will confess my iniquity
verses.second: and be sorry for my sin.

verses.first: Those who are my enemies without cause are mighty,
verses.second: and many in number are those who wrongfully hate me.

verses.first: Those who repay evil for good slander me,
verses.second: because I follow the course that is right.

verses.first: O Lord, do not forsake me;
verses.second: be not far from me, O my God.

verses.first: Make haste to help me,
verses.second: O Lord of my salvation.

verses.first: I said, “I will keep watch upon my ways,
verses.second: so that I do not offend with my tongue.

verses.first: I will put a muzzle on my mouth
verses.second: while the wicked are in my presence.”

verses.first: So I held my tongue and said nothing;
verses.second: I refrained from rash words; but my pain became unbearable.

verses.first: My heart was hot within me; while I pondered, the fire burst into flame;
verses.second: I spoke out with my tongue:

verses.first: Lord, let me know my end and the number of my days,
verses.second: so that I may know how short my life is.

verses.first: You have given me a mere handful of days, and my lifetime is as nothing in your sight;
verses.second: truly, even those who stand erect are but a puff of wind.

verses.first: We walk about like a shadow, and in vain we are in turmoil;
verses.second: we heap up riches and cannot tell who will gather them.

verses.first: And now, what is my hope?
verses.second: O Lord, my hope is in you.

verses.first: Deliver me from all my transgressions
verses.second: and do not make me the taunt of the fool.

verses.first: I fell silent and did not open my mouth,
verses.second: for surely it was you that did it.

verses.first: Take your affliction from me;
verses.second: I am worn down by the blows of your hand.

verses.first: With rebukes for sin you punish us; like a moth you eat away all that is dear to us;
verses.second: truly, everyone is but a puff of wind.

verses.first: Hear my prayer, O Lord, and give ear to my cry;
verses.second: hold not your peace at my tears.

verses.first: For I am but a sojourner with you,
verses.second: a wayfarer, as all my forebears were.

verses.first: Turn your gaze from me, that I may be glad again,
verses.second: before I go my way and am no more.

verses.first: I waited patiently upon the Lord;
verses.second: he stooped to me and heard my cry.

verses.first: He lifted me out of the desolate pit, out of the mire and clay;
verses.second: he set my feet upon a high cliff and made my footing sure.

verses.first: He put a new song in my mouth, a song of praise to our God;
verses.second: many shall see, and stand in awe, and put their trust in the Lord.

verses.first: Happy are they who trust in the Lord!
verses.second: they do not resort to evil spirits or turn to false gods.

verses.first: Great things are they that you have done, O Lord my God! how great your wonders and your plans for us!
verses.second: there is none who can be compared with you.

verses.first: Oh, that I could make them known and tell them!
verses.second: but they are more than I can count.

verses.first: In sacrifice and offering you take no pleasure
verses.second: (you have given me ears to hear you);

verses.first: Burnt-offering and sin-offering you have not required,
verses.second: and so I said, “Behold, I come.

verses.first: In the roll of the book it is written concerning me:
verses.second: ‘I love to do your will, O my God; your law is deep in my heart.’”

verses.first: I proclaimed righteousness in the great congregation;
verses.second: behold, I did not restrain my lips; and that, O Lord, you know.

verses.first: I Your righteousness have I not hidden in my heart; I have spoken of your faithfulness and your deliverance;
verses.second: I have not concealed your love and faithfulness from the great congregation.

verses.first: You are the Lord; do not withhold your compassion from me;
verses.second: let your love and your faithfulness keep me safe for ever,

verses.first: For innumerable troubles have crowded upon me; my sins have overtaken me, and I cannot see;
verses.second: they are more in number than the hairs of my head, and my heart fails me.

verses.first: Be pleased, O Lord, to deliver me;
verses.second: O Lord, make haste to help me.

verses.first: Let them be ashamed and altogether dismayed who seek after my life to destroy it;
verses.second: let them draw back and be disgraced who take pleasure in my misfortune.

verses.first: Let those who say “Aha!” and gloat over me be confounded,
verses.second: because they are ashamed.

verses.first: Let all who seek you rejoice in you and be glad;
verses.second: let those who love your salvation continually say, “Great is the Lord!”

verses.first: Though I am poor and afflicted,
verses.second: the Lord will have regard for me.

verses.first: You are my helper and my deliverer;
verses.second: do not tarry, O my God.

verses.first: Happy are they who consider the poor and needy!
verses.second: the Lord will deliver them in the time of trouble.

verses.first: The Lord preserves them and keeps them alive, so that they may be happy in the land;
verses.second: he does not hand them over to the will of their enemies.

verses.first: The Lord sustains them on their sickbed
verses.second: and ministers to them in their illness.

verses.first: I said, “Lord, be merciful to me;
verses.second: heal me, for I have sinned against you.”

verses.first: My enemies are saying wicked things about me:
verses.second: “When will he die, and his name perish?”

verses.first: Even if they come to see me, they speak empty words;
verses.second: their heart collects false rumors; they go outside and spread them.

verses.first: All my enemies whisper together about me
verses.second: and devise evil against me.

verses.first: “A deadly thing,” they say, “has fastened on him;
verses.second: he has taken to his bed and will never get up again.”

verses.first: Even my best friend, whom I trusted, who broke bread with me,
verses.second: has lifted up his heel and turned against me.

verses.first: But you, O Lord, be merciful to me and raise me up,
verses.second: and I shall repay them.

verses.first: By this I know you are pleased with me,
verses.second: that my enemy does not triumph over me.

verses.first: In my integrity you hold me fast,
verses.second: and shall set me before your face for ever.

verses.first: Blessed be the Lord God of Israel,
verses.second: from age to age. Amen. Amen. Book Two

verses.first: As the deer longs for the water-brooks,
verses.second: so longs my soul for you, O God.

verses.first: My soul is athirst for God, athirst for the living God;
verses.second: when shall I come to appear before the presence of God?

verses.first: My tears have been my food day and night,
verses.second: while all day long they say to me, “Where now is your God?”

verses.first: I pour out my soul when I think on these things:
verses.second: how I went with the multitude and led them into the house of God,

verses.first: With the voice of praise and thanksgiving,
verses.second: among those who keep holy-day.

verses.first: Why are you so full of heaviness, O my soul?
verses.second: and why are you so disquieted within me?

verses.first: Put your trust in God;
verses.second: for I will yet give thanks to him, who is the help of my countenance, and my God.

verses.first: My soul is heavy within me;
verses.second: therefore I will remember you from the land of Jordan, and from the peak of Mizar among the heights of Hermon.

verses.first: One deep calls to another in the noise of your cataracts;
verses.second: all your rapids and floods have gone over me.

verses.first: The Lord grants his loving-kindness in the daytime;
verses.second: in the night season his song is with me, a prayer to the God of my life.

verses.first: I will say to the God of my strength, “Why have you forgotten me?
verses.second: and why do I go so heavily while the enemy oppresses me?”

verses.first: While my bones are being broken,
verses.second: my enemies mock me to my face;

verses.first: All day long they mock me
verses.second: and say to me, “Where now is your God?”

verses.first: Why are you so full of heaviness, O my soul?
verses.second: and why are you so disquieted within me?

verses.first: Put your trust in God;
verses.second: for I will yet give thanks to him, who is the help of my countenance, and my God.

verses.first: Give judgment for me, O God, and defend my cause against an ungodly people;
verses.second: deliver me from the deceitful and the wicked.

verses.first: For you are the God of my strength; why have you put me from you?
verses.second: and why do I go so heavily while the enemy oppresses me?

verses.first: Send out your light and your truth, that they may lead me,
verses.second: and bring me to your holy hill and to your dwelling;

verses.first: That I may go to the altar of God, to the God of my joy and gladness;
verses.second: and on the harp I will give thanks to you, O God my God.

verses.first: Why are you so full of heaviness, O my soul?
verses.second: and why are you so disquieted within me?

verses.first: Put your trust in God;
verses.second: for I will yet give thanks to him, who is the help of my countenance, and my God.

verses.first: We have heard with our ears, O God, our forefathers have told us,
verses.second: the deeds you did in their days, in the days of old.

verses.first: How with your hand you drove the peoples out and planted our forefathers in the land;
verses.second: how you destroyed nations and made your people flourish.
